description: This file provides utility functions for handling file storage, including saving uploaded files, retrieving file paths, deleting files, and saving byte content to files within a specified storage directory. It also references project-specific settings for storage path configuration.

methods.name: get_storage_dir(kind)
methods.description: Determines the storage directory path based on a given kind, creating it if necessary, using the configured file storage path or defaults to 'processed'.

methods.name: save_upload_file(upload_file: UploadFile, kind: str)
methods.description: Saves an uploaded file to the designated storage directory under a uniquely generated filename and returns its ID and full path.

methods.name: get_file_path(path)
methods.description: Returns the provided logical file path without modification.

methods.name: delete_file_if_exists(path)
methods.description: Attempts to delete the file at the specified path if it exists, suppressing any exceptions.

methods.name: save_file_bytes(bytes_content, out_path)
methods.description: Writes byte content to a specified file path and returns the output path.
